english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for two matching things taken together or two people forming a couple.

exampleSentences.english: This pair of shoes goes well with my trousers.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 jat1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 can3 ngo5 tiu4 fu3

english.note: Use this for two matching or associated things considered as a pair, including a romantic couple when the pair is viewed as a unit.

exampleSentences.english: I bought a couple of matching sneakers.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 bo1 haai4
